testEnvironment: macOS arm64 host; Android 15 API 35 arm64 Pixel 10 device-profile emulator; Pixel 10 GL066 / Android 17; test-only shared debug signer
boundary: The fresh emulator run proves the updated APK installs and passes 5/5 signer, Binder, Headless JS no-model fail-closed, Platform, Tool and Android SQLite integration tests. TypeScript tests prove complete, orphan, unclosed and cross-token reasoning tags are filtered. The Pixel 10 offline UI retest proves CLEAN_OK without raw reasoning tags. It does not prove production signing, SELinux in the final image, OS-image integration, flash or boot.
